label_extent — DRIVE ttc op

• Data kinds: labels2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.label_extent(label, value: 'int') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import drivettc; drivettc.label_extent(label, value: 'int') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("label_extent"))

Usage

Bounding box of the pixels with value value in a label image: {"col0", "col1", "row0", "row1", "width", "height", "n"}.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

幅・高さは画素数(col1 − col0 + 1)。無ければ全部 0。ttc_from_scale の入力(完全な検出器の代役)。
